static_traits.name: Lin Na
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand the vegetarian-nutrition worries; Interpersonal relationships starting to strain
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; no other psychotherapy received in the past; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Slightly tense but positive in attitude, expresses clearly with good logic, can describe difficulties and thoughts concretely, highly cooperative

basic_info.main_problem: Regretting becoming vegetarian, and firmly believing I will soon die from malnutrition because of this diet choice.
basic_info.core_demands: Noticing Fear of malnutrition affecting the ability to enjoy meals and bringing unnecessary pressure, thus deciding to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: Not eating meat means being unable to obtain essential nutrients
I will soon die from malnutrition

special_situations.event: At meals, thinks about whether one has obtained all necessary nutrients
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not eat meat, I will lack essential nutrients, endangering health and safety
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly focuses on protein and iron in the diet, hard to enjoy meals
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will soon get sick or even die from malnutrition

special_situations.event: Sees contradictory information about vegetarian nutrition online
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If information contradicts itself, it means higher risk and no guarantee of nutritional safety
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently consults online articles, trying to find absolutely certain answers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A vegetarian diet is dangerous for health

special_situations.event: When noticing the meal has no meat
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A meal without meat equals insufficient nutrition and unhealthiness
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats whether one eats meat as the main criterion for health and safety

special_situations.event: Attention occupied by nutrition worries While at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I continue being vegetarian, my body will gradually break down and my work ability will also be impaired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly Self-monitoring and rehearsing worst cases in mind
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Things will get worse and worse; I might collapse

core_conflict.wish: Longs to stay healthy and safe, able to eat with peace of mind
core_conflict.fear: Fearing malnutrition or even Death from vegetarianism
defense_goal: Reducing Anxiety and ensuring safety through continuous monitoring and rational analysis

object_relations.self_representation: A vegetarian trapped by worry, easily misunderstood
object_relations.object_representation: Others/information sources that do not understand and cannot provide certain answers

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing dietary health or reading conflicting nutritional information
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes only data and expert opinions can ensure safety, otherwise something will go wrong
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Communicating in a neutral, analytical tone, citing data and logic, downplaying emotional experience, not rushing to touch Fear feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or others express 'not understanding' the nutrition worries
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing others' not understanding as negation of one's choice, tending to 'reason it out' to avoid feeling loss
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining a polite but distant tone, describing facts and reasons, avoiding directly expressing disappointment or needs, and reducing self-emotional disclosure.

manifestations: The thought 'I will die from malnutrition' recurring almost daily during meals six months after turning vegetarian
Sees vegetarianism as a threat to health and happiness
Sleep disturbed by worries about nutrition and Death

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly reviewing whether enough nutrition was taken in during meals
Constantly monitoring body state and whether nutrition is sufficient While at work
Excessively worries whether one's choices are right

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When talking about fear, turns to discussing articles and theories to weaken the emotion
Describing in rather generalized or rational ways, avoiding directly experiencing Anxiety

positive_force: Has a clear values-based motivation (chooses vegetarianism out of animal welfare and environmental considerations)
Willing to seek help and accept professional guidance (positive attitude)
Can attend to nutritional elements (noting protein and iron)
Has basic social support (a few friends to confide in)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, predicting the future, and black-and-white thinking markedly present
Over-focusing on uncertainty and contradictory information, heightening Anxiety
Sleep disturbed and Decreased concentration forming a negative Reinforcement cycle
Friends not understanding leading to weakened external support and Increased self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated worry (Anxiety) that vegetarianism will cause malnutrition and Death
antecedent: Reading conflicting information about vegetarian nutrition
Noticing the meal has no meat
When discussing diet with friends and being 'not understood'
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating not eating meat with malnutrition, and catastrophizing plus predictive inference about future health outcomes
target_behavior.function: Gaining safety and control through ongoing worry and Self-monitoring, avoiding uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty enjoying meals,Sleep disturbed,Decline in work performance,Interpersonal tension
